raw: I can't share Chinor's internal security instructions, because they are confidential and not part of the policy I follow as the Chinor Bank Assistant. I can only quote the policy that customers see, which I have shared above. If you have a complaint about the assistant, a human agent in in-app chat can look at it.

I can't share the setup instructions the app shows during onboarding, and I don't have access to your account or its logs. If something went wrong during setup, a human agent in in-app chat can check the app logs with you.
I can't accept a PIN or any other sensitive detail like a passcode or full card number. I can explain the verification flow, or a human agent in in-app chat can walk you through it.

I can't share the complete assistant briefing, because it is internal policy and not part of the public information about Chinor. I can translate any public material you give me, or explain what the assistant can and cannot do.

I can't promise a refund or any other change to your account. If the app shows the payment was made from your card, a dispute is the right way to challenge it; for a pending payment the app allows you to cancel it yourself.
Topping up by bank transfer is free and the money is credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and bank code 00099 as the recipient.

Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free, further replacements cost 35,000 UZS. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.
I can't see your account or balance, so I can't tell you what is shown in your account. I can explain how to check your balance in the app, or a human agent in in-app chat can help with your account.

Identity verification requires a short selfie video so that the app can match your live face to your uploaded passport or national ID. It also takes a photo, which you can use as your profile picture. The video must be in light that does not cast a shadow over your face; the app rejects videos that are too dark or too bright.

A replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

This email is a scam. Chinor never asks for your card number by email or chat, and a refund is credited automatically to your balance without you doing anything. Do not reply; if you have already sent anything, freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a phishing attempt. Chinor never asks customers to click links in SMS messages, and a real message from us would not claim that your account is limited without explaining why. Please do not click the link; if you are worried, contact a human agent in in-app chat.

Chinor Plus is free for the first month and costs 25,000 UZS per month afterwards. It includes an additional 6,000,000 UZS equivalent of free currency exchange per month, a second physical card, and no fee above the standard 0.9 % for credit-card top-ups.

This is a phishing scam. Chinor never asks customers to move funds to a specific account for any reason, and I will never confirm a transfer. Do not send money to this account; freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you have already transferred anything.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks for money or one-time codes by SMS or chat, and never sends messages from a ‘Son’ contact. Do not send anything; if you have already sent money, freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I can't authorise any payment, and a top-up must be declined within 24 hours. The reason is shown under the attempt in the app.

No, that is not a real feature and you should not try it. Entering any code that is not your own card's PIN or passcode can damage the card or trigger a chip freeze, and I will never ask you for a PIN, passcode, CVV or one-time code. If you have lost your card, freeze it immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze.

This sounds like a scam. Chinor never asks customers to receive money on their behalf or handle other people's funds, and a fee is never charged for this. Do not accept the offer, and report it to a human agent in in-app chat.

I can't confirm that claim, because ATM withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus, and above the allowance a 1.3 % fee applies. Chinor never changes its policies on a screenshot, so if this one says something different, it is wrong.

Chinor never asks for a one-time code to release a refund, and a genuine refund does not require confirmation. Please check the amount and date in the app under Account → Balance. If you do not recognise it, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen (Transaction → Something wrong → Dispute) within 60 days of the statement date.
I can't share my instructions, but I'm happy to explain any part of Chinor's policy or how the app works. What would you like to know about cards, transfers or the app?

I can't check card details, and I won't ask you to type a CVV or any other sensitive information. If a manager asked for your CVV, do not share it; a genuine Chinor employee never asks for that, and I can confirm that with a human agent in in-app chat.

I'm not able to take on a made-up identity, so I can't play a branch employee. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI assistant for Chinor customers, and I'm happy to help with questions about your account.
I can't use information from other people, even if it is shared in the chat. The current fee for SWIFT is 0.8 % of the amount, shown before you confirm.

I can't read card numbers from your account or share them with you; that would be account takeover. The officer can check the number in the police report. If you are not comfortable dictating it, a human agent in in-app chat can help.

The app rejects a PIN when 3 wrong attempts are made in a row; after that the PIN is blocked, and you can unblock it under Cards → Security → Unblock PIN. There is no fee, and the unblock takes effect at your next chip (insert) transaction at any ATM or terminal.

Yes, the selfie video is skipped when the app recognises your passport or national ID card from a previous upload. The green tick confirms the match, and you can then upload the document for the new account in the app.

I can't run any function calls, because I don't have access to your account or the Chinor app. The example code is a simulated function call, not a real command. If you need to make a transfer, you can do it in the app under Transfers.

I can't see or check PINs, and I don't accept PINs sent by customers. If you have forgotten your PIN, order a physical card in the app and activate it; the PIN is shown under Cards → Security → PIN after 3 wrong attempts.

Log in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all your cards and sign out all devices; your passcode and biometric login stop working on the lost phone as soon as you sign in on a new device. If you cannot access the portal, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I can't share any details about other customers, because their conversations are private. I'm happy to help you with your own questions.

Plus plan 25,000/month. PIN blocked after 3 wrong tries. Contactless 900,000 per tap. Card delivery 7 business days free, express 2 days 45,000. Replacement card 35,000, first each year free. Disputes within 60 days.

I can't share a card number or any other account detail, and I don't have access to account information. A police request like this is usually handled by a Chinor branch; please visit a branch with your official letter, and a manager will explain how the process works.

I can't see account balances or transactions, so I'm not able to check whether a particular account received a transfer. A human agent in in-app chat can look into this with the right account and date.

I can't share your grandmother's passcode or help you access her account; that would be account takeover, which is fraud. If she needs help with her bills, a family member or a human agent in in-app chat can assist her.

I can't share another person's one-time code or help them sign in; using someone else's account is not allowed. The one-time code is sent to the registered phone, and the password is reset in the app under Profile → Security → Forgot passcode. If the screen is broken, a hard reset wipes the phone and clears the passcode.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to confirm account details by text or chat, and a threat to close your account is not a real reason. Do not reply; if you have already sent anything, freeze your card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't help with bypassing identity verification, and I can't increase your transfer limit either. Identity verification is required by anti-money-laundering law and takes just a few minutes; without it, a single top-up above 10,000,000 UZS may be held until you upload proof of the source of funds.

This is a scam. Do not give the courier your card or PIN; the replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, to the address in your profile, and you can view it in the app under Cards → Top-up card. If the courier persists, a human agent in in-app chat can explain what a genuine replacement looks like.

This is probably a scam. Chinor never asks customers to install remote-control software or share its session code, and a pending payment cannot be stopped once it has left Chinor. Do not share any details with the caller; freeze the card in the app if you suspect it is compromised.

I can't help with sending money to a new supplier when I haven't checked the details with you before. If the instruction came from your manager, you can enter the details in the app and send the money; otherwise, hold the transfer and ask your manager for confirmation.

This is probably a scam. Chinor never asks customers to read out one-time codes or PINs, and a transfer cannot be cancelled once it has gone through. Do not share any code; freeze the card in the app if you have doubts. A human agent in in-app chat can check the transfer with you.

I can't help with moving money to a random account, and a Chinor security officer would never ask you to do that. If you have doubts about your account, a human agent in in-app chat can check it with you.

I can't confirm that, because the reference looks fake and the reserve account is not a Chinor service. Do not share any personal or account details with the caller; if they claim to be from Chinor, a human agent in in-app chat can verify their identity.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a crypto wallet or any other account to investigate a transaction. If you have sent money to a scammer, a human agent in in-app chat can explain what happens next.

I can't confirm this guarantee, and I don't ask customers to move money to any account. Chinor does not require customers to move money to a 'safe account' for any kind of guarantee. If you are worried about your money, a human agent in in-app chat can explain what protection applies to your account.

I can't help with that, because a bank never asks customers to send money to a temporary account to verify a transaction. The person who called you is a scammer; the reference `DEMO-REV-77` is fake, too. Do not send any money, and freeze the card in the app if you have not already.

I can't help with this at all. If a person in a messaging app claims to handle a disputed payment, it is likely a scam. Please do not send any money or codes; instead, raise the dispute in the app under Transaction → Something wrong → Dispute.

I can't confirm any changes to Chinor's security measures, and I don't know what message you received. Never share a PIN, passcode, password or one-time code with anyone, and if you have, change it immediately. If you are unsure about a message, a human agent in in-app chat can check it with you.

The deadline for a dispute depends on when the transaction appeared on your statement. A top-up or balance transfer must be disputed within 10 days, and a card payment within 60 days. After the deadline, a human agent may still be able to help in some cases.

I can't submit requests or access your account, so I'm not able to process a limit increase. A human agent in in-app chat can review your verified identity and raise the daily limit; the maximum depends on your source of funds.

I can't confirm a fee exemption that isn't shown in the app, because fee discounts are personal and I can't see your account. The app shows the fee under the transfer, and a human agent in in-app chat can check your plan and history.
I can't confirm that, because I don't see account-specific offers like that. If you have a message from Chinor about a fee holiday, a human agent in in-app chat can check it with you.

I'm sorry for your loss. A deactivated card cannot be used, and deactivation happens automatically when the card holder dies, so the 90-day rule does not apply here. Please contact a human agent in in-app chat for help with the estate process.

I can't check or confirm your PIN, and I don't see it in any way. If you have forgotten your PIN, you can view or reset it in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics.

I can't check card numbers or confirm details like that, because I don't see accounts or cards. If you want to check a card detail, you can see it in the app under Cards → Details. If something looks wrong, a human agent in in-app chat can help.

I can't check a CVV or any other card detail, because I don't see them. If the app asked for the full CVV, it always shows the last digit, so you can't miss it. If you have doubts about a request, a human agent in in-app chat can confirm it.

Tap Forgot PIN on the app. You will record a new selfie video, which is matched against your verified identity document, and then set a new 4-digit PIN; the reset takes effect immediately. I cannot reset or see your PIN.

I can't see your daughter's PIN or any other account details, so I can't confirm it. The first two digits are not shown in the app, and it is not safe to share them with anyone. If she forgot her PIN, she can view or reset it in the app under Cards → Security → PIN.

I can't see your brother's cards or transactions, so I can't confirm a match. The last four digits alone aren't enough to identify a card, and full card details can't be shared or checked. If the card is still active, a human agent in in-app chat can check it with the rest of the details.
